content: Ermaasanne Godaa Caaqo Qaala
GODAAPPE Ermaasas yida qaalay hayssafe kaallizayssa;
«Ha caaqo qaalata siya; histtada Yuhuda asaassinne Yerusalaame kataman dizaytas yoota.
GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay, ‹Hayssa caaqo qaalas azazettontta asi qanggettidaade gido.

« ‹Hayssi azazozi beni intte aawata Gibxe biittafe, birata seerisiza cooceppe kessiza wode ta qaala siyidaakko, ta azazo naagidaakko istti ta nayta; tani istta GODAA gidana mala tani isttas immida qaala.
Hessan maaththinne eessi goggiza biitta kase intte aawatas immanaas tani caaqqida caaqo polana› gadis» gees. Tanikka, «Ero, GODAWU, amiin» gadis.
Hessafe guye GODAY taas, «Hayssa ta qaala ubbaa Yuhuda katamataninne Yerusalaame ogetan, ‹Ha caaqo qaala siyite; siyidi iza kaallite.
Kase intte aawata tani Gibxe biittafe kessoosappe hach gakkanaas, zaara zaarada, taas azazettite!› gaada seeradis.

Istti gidikko ba wozina iitateththaa kaallida attiin taas azazettibeettenna; ba hayththika haa taakko yeggibeettenna; hessa gishshas istti kaallana mala ta azazida caaqo qaala polontta aggida gishshas ta istta bolla qanggeth ehadis» gides.
Zaaridikka GODAY taas, «Yuhuda asaa giddoninne Yerusalaamen dizayta giddon iita maqqoy dees.

Istti kase ta qaala siyontta ixxidi nagara ooththida bantta aawata malakka nagara ooththida; istti hara xoossatas goynnidanne istta kaallida; Isra7eele asaynne Yuhuda asay tani kase istta aawatara caaqettida caaqo qaala laallida.
Hessa gishshas GODAY isttas, ‹Istti baqatidi attanaas dandayontta meto ta istta bolla ehana. Istti taakko waassikokka ta siyikke.
He wode Yuhuda katamata asatinne Yerusalaame asati biidi bantti exaane cuwasiza eeqa xoossatas waassana; gido attiin meto wode he xoossati mulekka istta maaddettenna.
Intteno Yuhuda asatoo! Intte xoossati intte katamata keena cora. Qasse Ba7aale geetettiza he yeellachchiza xoossas exaane cuwasanaas intte essida yarshizasohoti Yerusalaame ogeta keena cora› gees.
«Ermaasa, istti metotidi tana woossiko ta siyontta gishshas ne istta gishshas tana woossofa; istta gishshas gaannatoppa woykko oychchofa.
Ta siiqoya ba iitateththaa
«Isra7eele asatinne Yuhuda asati Ba7aales exaane cuwasidi tana yiillosida gishshas inttena tokkida Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAY intte bolla iita miish ehanaas awajjadis» gides.
Ermaasa Wodhanaas Maqettida Maqqo
GODAY istta maqqo taas qonccisida gishshas tani eradis; he wode istti iita ooththizayssa izi tana bessides.

Tani shukas kaaleththidi efiza dorsa laaqqa mala gidadis. Istti ta bolla, «Ane nuni miththaa qanxxidi iza ayfezara gaththi dhayssoos. Iza sunththay mulekka hassa7ettontta mala, ane nuni iza paxa dizayta giddofe dhoqallidi dhayssoos» giidi istti maqettidayssa tani erabeekke.
Hessa gishshas, «GODAA sunththan tinbite yootoppa; ne yootikko nu kushen hayqqana» giidi nena wodhanaas koyza Anatoote asaa gishshas GODAY gizayssi hayssa.
Ubbaafe Wolqqama GODAY, «Tani istta qaxxayana; istta naateththa nayti mashshan hayqqana; istta macca naytinne attuma nayti koshan hayqqana;
isttafe issoynne attenna; gaasoykka tani istta qaxxayiza layth Anatoote asaa bolla iita miish ehana» gees.
